n: the dimension of the real vector space and the size of the square matrices
Q: the given real n-by-n orthogonal matrix
u: the given vector in real n-space satisfying u transpose times u equals 1
H: the matrix I minus 2 times u times u transpose
v: a vector in real n-space used in the hypothesis about fixed vectors of Q
w: the nonzero vector in real n-space constructed as (I-Q) inverse applied to u
